_comment: A character's own progress (active, completed, failed, objective checkmarks) is stored on the character record, not here. This file is the quest catalog staff build from.

quests.name: Ash and Embers
quests.description: A supply cart went missing on the road through Ashfall District. Find out what happened to it.

objectives.text: Reach the last known position of the supply cart
Deal with whatever is guarding it
Recover at least half of the original cargo

quests.name: The Glass Between
quests.description: Residents near The Hollow Gallery report movement in windows that should be empty. Investigate before someone gets hurt.

objectives.text: Enter The Hollow Gallery after dark
Confront the source of the sightings

quests.name: Choir at the Gate
quests.description: A fixed site guarded by an Iron Choir Sentinel is blocking access to a location the party needs to reach.

objectives.text: Pass through the gate before it reactivates

quests.name: What the Uncounted Left
quests.description: A scenario failed without resolution years ago. Something is still out there, and it has stopped staying in one place.

objectives.text: Track the anomaly across at least two sightings
Force a confrontation on the party's terms
